description: An IT manager at a health informatics company is modernizing the Oracle HR database archival strategy. The JOB_HISTORY table contains historical employment records but lacks partitioning, making range-based purges expensive. Your task: (1) Create a range-partitioned table EMPLOYEE_HISTORY_ARCHIVE partitioned by END_DATE with 4 decade partitions (before 1990, 1990s, 2000s, 2010+), (2) migrate all rows from JOB_HISTORY into this new table, (3) create bitmap indexes on JOB_ID and DEPARTMENT_ID columns of the archive table, (4) create a materialized view MV_DEPT_TURNOVER that shows per-department job change counts from the archive, and (5) save a partition analysis report to /home/ga/Desktop/archive_analysis.txt showing row counts per partition. All objects must be valid and the archive must contain all original JOB_HISTORY rows.
